newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf rigs under contract up 1 at 163.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf rigs under contract up 1 at 163.

text.p: There were 163 rigs under contract in the U.S. Gulf as of January 31, up one from the period ending January 24, Offshore Data Services said Friday.
The utilization rate for rigs working in the Gulf, based on a total fleet of 183, was 89.1 percent.
The number of working rigs in the European/Mediterranean area remained unchanged at 105 rigs under contract out of a total fleet of 106, a utilization rate of 99.1 pct.
The worldwide rig count rose six to 563 out of a total fleet of 606, making the utilization rate 92.9 percent.
